Variants.Content: The sacred grove of the Northern Castle is both a private place of prayer and a part of family history. The lord faces silent witnesses here, and the servants and children learn to be reverent here; it does not require a gorgeous ceremony, but it can make a promise appear harder to break than the words in the hall back.
